Given below are two statements :

Statement I: The work done by electrostatic force on a point charge in a closed loop is zero.

Statement II: Electrostatic field is a conservative field.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

A solid sphere of mass 5 kg and radius 10 cm is kept in contact with another solid sphere of mass 10 kg and radius 20 cm. The moment of inertia of this pair of spheres about the tangent passing through the point of contact is ____ kg m².

The minimum frequency of photon required to break a particle of mass 15.348 amu into 4 \alpha particles is ____ kHz. [mass of He nucleus = 4.002 amu, 1 amu = 1.66\times 10^{-27} kg, h = 6.6\times 10^{-34} J s, c = 3\times 10^8 m/s]
